title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %

body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We value our cooperation and we understand the cost pressure on your side; we want an agreement that keeps our partnership healthy for both of us.
We have noted that rising metal-industry wages make up a substantial share of your foundry's costs. Our proposal confirms a binding volume, and we invite you to consider it as a complete package.

We confirm a binding volume of 4000 units a year for the 24-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is on file (cost:part:PH-100).
Your letter (doc:D01-LETTER) gives less notice than our agreement provides for (ctr:D01-FRAMEWORK).

On this basis we propose: EUR 48.90 per unit, payment 60 days net, 24 months, valid from 2027-01-01, for our full demand of 4000 units a year over 24 months.

What would you need from us to move further on the price? We are open to discussing any term that helps you.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. In recognition of the framework agreement's notice period, we agree to an effective date of 1 January 2027. We appreciate your commitment to a binding volume of 4000 units over 24 months, which strengthens our long-standing partnership.

For our updated Angebot, we present a price of €51.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: a price of €50.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027.

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
